answer: The onyx register is checked at draw time, thread lists the eligible set, and ivory seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 81 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 81 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 15 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
